description: The Anhui crop-residue research team publishes county-level crop production, residue quantities and bioenergy-potential estimates in Excel workbooks. GitHub documents a province-wide five-crop panel for 2020–2024 and a four-crop panel for forty-seven major grain counties for 2015–2024. The release includes theoretical and collectable biomass and energy, calculated using crop-specific conversion and collection coefficients. Its LICENSE file grants CC BY 4.0 for the derivative dataset, requiring credit to creators, the article and original statistical yearbooks; access is free. These regional estimates can supply bioenergy planning simulations. Coverage is limited by collection assumptions and statistical aggregation units, which affect interpretation as physically recoverable supply. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Anhui crop-residue biomass and bioenergy potential
notes: G4-0329; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
